triggers.detailsText: Industrial activity remained robust, with Index of Industrial Production, IIP, growth accelerating to 6.8% in H1 FY 2026-27, up from 4.4% in H1 FY 202526. Against this supportive macroeconomic backdrop, the Commercial Vehicle Industry delivered an exceptional performance, with CV more than 6-ton production growing by 47.7% in Q2 FY 2026-27. Over the coming quarters, we plan further investments to expand capacity across all brake system aggregates, so we stay ahead of anticipated market demand.

triggers.detailsText: 1 crore = 10 million Refer to annexure for Details of Instruments & Bank Facilities Detailed Rationale Crisil Ratings has upgraded its ratings on the bank facilities of Suyog Telematics Limited (STL) to 'Crisil BBB+/Stable/Crisil A2' from ‘'Crisil BBB/Stable/Crisil A3+’. Key Rating Drivers - Strengths Established regional market position: STL, established in 1995 by Mr Shivshankar Lature, has built a strong regional market position as a provider of passive telecommunication infrastructure provider, including poles, towers, optical fiber cables, and related assets. Key Rating Drivers - Weaknesses Large capital requirement: Suyog’s planned tower expansion, which builds on recent additions that have broadened its geographic presence, is expected to require capex of around Rs 200–250 crore per annum over the medium term.
